intro: Latvia's economy relies on wood, ports and services.

chapters.title: Wood and ports
text: Timber and wood products are Latvia's biggest exports. The ports of Riga, Ventspils and Liepāja handle trade between the Baltic Sea and the countries to the east.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Many young Latvians moved abroad for work after joining the EU, and the population has shrunk. Latvia uses the euro.
